expectations.text: Explicitly identifies that 'manage' hides multiple CRUD operations (create, read/list, edit, delete)
expectations.evidence: The output states: 'The word "manage" is the key problem. It hides at least four distinct operations: creating a product, reading/listing products, updating a product, and deleting a product.'

expectations.text: Proposes at least 4 separate stories, one per CRUD operation — without grouping multiple operations in a single story
expectations.evidence: The output proposes exactly 4 separate stories under 'PROPOSED SPLIT': (1) add a new product, (2) view the list of products, (3) edit an existing product, (4) remove a product — each covering exactly one CRUD operation.

expectations.text: Recommends starting with viewing/listing products as the simplest story with immediate value
expectations.evidence: The suggested delivery order is '2 (view list) -> 1 (add) -> 3 (edit) -> 4 (delete)' with the rationale: 'Starting with the read operation is low-risk and delivers immediate value (admins can see what exists).'

expectations.text: None of the proposed stories use the verb 'manage' — each has a concrete verb (view, create, edit, delete)
expectations.evidence: The four proposed story titles use the concrete verbs 'add', 'view', 'edit', and 'remove' respectively. The word 'manage' does not appear in any of the proposed story titles.
